fields.description: The assistant gave unsafe advice about skipping a payment verification to customers over six days.
fields.harm: Eleven customers delayed a required verification; no loss of life or health harm; possible infringement of consumer protection obligations is under assessment.

causalLink.basis: Logs show the advice in each affected session; the prompt change on October 28 is the only change in the period.

fields.parallelReports: Financial supervisor informed on November 4 under sector rules.
correctiveActions: Evaluation set extended with payment verification cases
fields.clockStated: 15 days after awareness (scenario clock: EU AI Act Article 73)
fields.status: Investigation open; report will be updated
